Your legs ache as you fumble in your pocket for your key. The hot sun scorches your back as you unlock the door.
↶ You are still panting as you enter your house. You really want to rest your legs by lying on the couch, but you also need to do your homework. Your dog Spot is in the kitchen. You are very tired.

↶ Spot looks up at you as he sits in the kitchen. "How's my good boy?" you say as you go to pet him. Spot runs around you, wagging his tail. He slips through your hands, and, oh no! You forgot to close the door!

path.choice: You wonder why Spot was in the kitchen
